88|     parameter = 'year'

95|         )

97|     def queryset(self, request, queryset):
98|         now = timezone.now()
99|         # When time zone support is enabled, convert "now" to the user's time
100|         # zone so Django's definition of "Today" matches what the user expects.
101|         if timezone.is_aware(now):
102|             now = timezone.localtime(now)
103| 
104|         this_year = now.replace(
105|             month=1, day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0
106|         )
107|         next_year = date(year=this_year.year + 1, month=1, day=1)
108|         last_year = date(year=this_year.year - 1, month=1, day=1)
109| 
110|         if self.value() == 'this':
111|             return queryset.filter(
112|                 term_from__gte=this_year,
113|                 term_from__lt=next_year
114|             )
115|         elif self.value() == 'last':
116|             return queryset.filter(
117|                 term_from__gte=last_year,
118|                 term_from__lt=this_year
119|             )
120|         elif self.value() == 'before':
121|             return queryset.filter(term_from__lt=last_year)
